pages.title: Empress Mahjong: Jade Palace
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Clear layered tile arrangements in Empress Mahjong: Jade Palace. Match identical pieces that are uncovered with an open side, removing every tile to complete a board. Use hints when needed, rely on automatic reshuffling when stuck, and replay levels for faster times.

pages.title: Water Sort Puzzle 3
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Separate mixed liquids in Water Sort Puzzle 3. Move colored water between containers until each color is grouped correctly. Plan the transfers around the space available so one pour does not prevent you from finishing the remaining sorting.

pages.title: Obby vs Zombies
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Build a defensive maze in Obby vs Zombies. Arrange different characters to resist the undead hordes moving toward you. Choose from the available attacking and defensive options, shaping your setup to stop the next group of zombies.

pages.title: FreeCell
pages.creator: QiGame
pages.description: Organize cards into descending, alternating-color columns in FreeCell. Use four free cells to hold cards temporarily while uncovering useful moves in the tableau. Plan ahead to empty the board and bring the shuffled deck into order.

pages.title: Falling Dummy
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Direct a ragdoll through a destructive fall in Falling Dummy. Push it from a construction-site roof and steer the body toward obstacles below. The objective is to cause as much damage to the dummy's bones as possible before the descent ends.

pages.title: Mysterious Familiars Enchanted Bestiary
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Discover magical creatures in Mysterious Familiars Enchanted Bestiary. Tap to fill a potion vessel and reveal a familiar or its next growth stage. Explore different locations, use speed bonuses, and keep a screenshot of a favorite creature.

pages.title: Cookie Land
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match desserts in Cookie Land to complete level objectives within a move limit. Swap neighboring sweets into groups of at least three and create chain reactions as new pieces arrive. Use boosters to handle harder tasks along the saga map.

pages.title: Two Stunt Racers
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive a customizable sports car around a stunt city in Two Stunt Racers. Try three modes or enter two-player competitions with a friend. Separate keyboard controls let both drivers race and test their handling within the same game.

pages.title: Popcorn Stack
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect and prepare snack packages in Popcorn Stack. Gather boxes, fill them with grain, and add cooking or topping steps along the process. Finish by covering and decorating the containers, turning the collected supplies into completed popcorn packages.

pages.title: Pop Party - Suika Watermelon
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Merge matching pieces inside a jar in Pop Party - Suika Watermelon. Create larger versions without letting the container overflow. Six tools, including bombs, a claw, and level-changing abilities, offer ways to alter the arrangement and continue merging.

pages.title: Gun Clone
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide automatically firing weapons through a runner course in Gun Clone. Collect cards and bonuses that improve or multiply the guns, then destroy obstacles ahead. Upgrade weapons during levels or through the main menu to build a more destructive setup.

pages.title: Gun Shooting Range
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Complete marksmanship missions in Gun Shooting Range. Start as a rookie sniper and aim to place precise shots with as little ammunition as possible. The shooting tasks focus on using the rifle accurately as you advance toward harder assignments.

pages.title: Unblock It 3D
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Rotate a block cluster and remove exposed pieces in Unblock It 3D. Each brick can slide only in its arrow's direction when nothing obstructs it. Clear the entire shape in classic puzzles or tackle the additional adventure stages.

pages.title: Lucky Vegas Blackjack
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play a casino-style card contest in Lucky Vegas Blackjack. Build a hand worth more than the house's total without exceeding twenty-one. Choose computer opponents or the local multiplayer arrangement with three hands as you make each card decision.

pages.title: Ace Car Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Weave through road hazards in Ace Car Racing. Collect lightning for fuel, coins for upgrades, and diamonds that open special vehicles. Improve attributes such as acceleration, speed, and nitro as you tackle its different road environments.

pages.title: Monster Vs Zombie
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Slide a creature through zombie-filled layouts in Monster Vs Zombie. It keeps moving until it reaches a wall or obstacle, so plan where each slide will end. Eat every zombie and reach the gate to complete the stage.

pages.title: Mind Games for 2-3-4 Player
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose from a collection of shared-screen activities in Mind Games for 2-3-4 Player. The selection includes matching, skill puzzles, pop-it, mancala, ludo, and tic-tac-toe. Take turns with the mouse and choose games suited to the number of people joining.

pages.title: Dont Tap
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Tap moving black keys to perform tunes in Dont Tap. Six modes with three difficulty settings vary the challenge and pace of the scrolling tiles. Keep selecting the correct keys as the screen moves to sustain the musical performance.

pages.title: Soccer Maze
pages.creator: ravel
pages.description: Guide a ball through a labyrinth in Soccer Maze. Work out the correct route to the opposing goal before your rival completes theirs. Separate keyboard controls let two players compete over the maze-based football challenge.

pages.title: Dead Aim Skibidi Toilets Attack
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Fight hostile fixtures invading city streets in Dead Aim Skibidi Toilets Attack. Move through the area, shoot the attackers, and reload as needed to survive. Progress unlocks additional weapon types, expanding your options for handling later encounters.

pages.title: Pool Party 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Burst matching water balloons in Pool Party 3. Form groups of three or more to meet the goals set by Bunni, using longer combinations to create explosive bonuses. Continue through the water-park puzzles and use power-ups on difficult boards.

pages.title: Jewels Blitz 6
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Explore temple-themed matching puzzles in Jewels Blitz 6. Combine identical gems to remove them and use special effects against jungle obstacles and magical seals. Progress up the map, complete extra challenges, and earn gold and magical items.

pages.title: Doctor kids Dentist Games
pages.creator: kid kat
pages.description: Treat several kinds of patients in Doctor kids Dentist Games. Choose activities involving teeth, feet, hands, or ears and use the provided medical tools. Clinic decoration options accompany the treatment tasks, combining care sequences with arranging the practice.

pages.title: PinBall Brick Mania
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Break numbered targets with bouncing shots in PinBall Brick Mania. Aim at the blocks and collect plus symbols to increase the number of balls you can fire. Clear the rising formation before it reaches the top of the playing area.

pages.title: Spot The Difference - Seasons
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compare changing landscapes in Spot The Difference - Seasons. Find the alterations between paired pictures across four seasonal settings. Five modes and eighty levels provide different searches as you work through the spring, summer, autumn, and winter imagery.

pages.title: Drop & Squish
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Create a patterned glass in Drop & Squish. Drop balls into the container and compress them to reproduce the requested reference image. Once the preparation is complete, choose to sell the creation to a buyer or destroy it with the available actions.

pages.title: Candy Rain 7
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Collect sweets and rewards through matching puzzles in Candy Rain 7. Build combinations to gather candies, waffles, and coin chests. Use boosters on difficult layouts and work through the saga map while trying to improve each level's score.

pages.title: Connect The Dots Game For Kids
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Trace numbered points in Connect The Dots Game For Kids. Begin at one and join the dots in sequence to reveal a picture. Completing it plays the picture's English name, and the untimed format lets you follow the numbers at your own pace.

pages.title: Word Search Emoji edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Search a grid for icon sequences in Word Search Emoji edition. Follow the requested series of emoji rather than spelling ordinary words. Compare the arrangement carefully to locate the complete sequence hidden among the other symbols.

pages.title: Hair Challenge
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Lengthen a character's hair during a run in Hair Challenge. Keep moving forward and touch the plus-one markers to add to its growth. The objective centers on collecting those increases and building a progressively longer hairstyle along the route.

pages.title: Circus Words
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Build hidden answers from letters in Circus Words. Swipe through the available characters to form words and complete each puzzle's missing entries. Keep testing letter combinations as later levels present additional vocabulary challenges.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Hello Love
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Search romantic scenes in Hidden Objects Hello Love. Find every item shown on the list before the timer expires. Use hints for difficult objects or zoom in and drag around the picture to inspect its smaller details.

pages.title: Super Oscar
pages.creator: CHORRUS GAMES S.L.
pages.description: Run and jump through a platform adventure in Super Oscar. Cross multiple worlds, avoid enemies, and use fireballs to deal with threats along the route. Unlock characters and costumes, improve their abilities, and experiment with different projectile types.

pages.title: Battle Royale Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Color action-game characters in Battle Royale Coloring Book. Choose one of twelve pictures and work with twenty-four colors and nine pencil sizes. Finish your design and use the print option to keep the colored image.

pages.title: Stickman City Shooting 3D
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Survive hostile stick figures in Stickman City Shooting 3D. Explore the city and use firearms, grenades, or available vehicles and turrets against armed enemies and bosses. Keep attacking while protecting your character from the opponents trying to kill you.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Survival Active Vulcan Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight prehistoric predators during a volcanic crisis in Dinosaurs Survival Active Vulcan Multiplayer. Play a campaign or join friends for survival waves against dinosaurs. Customize firearm camouflage and attachments while handling the threats across the different combat activities.

pages.title: Ideal Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Practice maneuvering a car in Ideal Car Parking. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer toward the required space. Work on your approach and final placement as you complete the game's driving and parking tasks.

pages.title: Girls and Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange paired character-and-vehicle pictures in Girls and Cars Slide. Choose one of three images and a puzzle mode, then restore the scene from its shuffled sections. Compare the details across the pieces to identify their correct arrangement.

pages.title: OK Parking
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Park a red sports car within a time limit in OK Parking. Drive through city streets, avoid traffic and obstacles, and enter the marked space without damaging the vehicle. Accurate maneuvering matters as much as reaching the destination quickly.

pages.title: Rope Unroll
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Free wrapped objects in Rope Unroll. Swipe to rotate the item and unwind the rope around it. Continue working the cord loose until the hidden object's shape is revealed and the wrapping has been removed.

pages.title: Popsicle Dream Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Match frozen treats in Popsicle Dream Match 3. Arrange at least three identical popsicles in a row to score while keeping the side gauge from dropping too far. Continue making useful combinations to preserve the game and improve your total.

pages.title: Soldier Way
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Cross a jungle combat course in Soldier Way. Gather diamonds and medals, shoot enemies, and unlock the door leading onward. Six platforming levels introduce different opponents as you guide the soldier with movement and firing controls.

pages.title: Princesses Doll Fantasy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare a palace fashion show in Princesses Doll Fantasy. Create doll-inspired looks using dresses with bows, ruffles, and flounces, then dress the sisters as models. Coordinate their outfits to present the new collection they have designed.

pages.title: Idle Fish
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a collection of aquatic creatures in Idle Fish. Buy fish with coins and merge identical ones into larger varieties. Prices rise with repeated purchases, so combine your existing stock while working toward discovering the mysterious idle fish.

pages.title: ATV Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride an all-terrain vehicle through traffic in ATV Traffic. Choose among three machines, four environments, and timed, endless, or fuel-based modes. Steer between hazards, use nitro to accelerate, and brake when you need more control.

pages.title: Spaceship Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild spacecraft illustrations in Spaceship Jigsaw. Complete puzzles to earn money, with harder modes providing larger rewards. Spend the earnings on additional images and work through the ten-picture collection at your chosen difficulty.

pages.title: Flip Juggling
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Flip an object and make it land upright in Flip Juggling. Begin with water-bottle-style throws and explore a selection of unusual flippable items. Successful landings earn points as you work on timing the rotation and landing.

pages.title: Hexamatch
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Push colored hexagons into matching stacks in Hexamatch. Click a piece to move it along its indicated direction, shoving any hexagons ahead of it. Plan the order of moves so every color ends up grouped together.

pages.title: Mini Golf Adventure
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Putt through obstacle courses in Mini Golf Adventure. Aim to sink the ball in fewer strokes for more stars, and collect gems to improve the score. Magnets, teleporters, wind devices, and other course elements create different routing possibilities.

pages.title: ZigZag Snow Ski
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a skier downhill in ZigZag Snow Ski. Change direction to follow the winding route and keep the descent under control. The challenge is to continue navigating the mountain course as each turn calls for another well-timed adjustment.

pages.title: Heavy Combat
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Complete combat missions in Heavy Combat as an elite mercenary. Fight terrorists across three locations, each containing ten levels with different objectives. Work through the assignments while handling the armed opposition encountered throughout the maps.

pages.title: Ariel Princess Vs Mermaid
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create two versions of a royal character in Ariel Princess Vs Mermaid. Dress her for an event as a mermaid, then build a separate princess look. Compare the finished styles and decide which interpretation you prefer.

pages.title: Jeff The Killer Horrendous Smile
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Investigate a haunted home in Jeff The Killer Horrendous Smile. Search for answers, solve puzzles, and defend yourself from Jeff and the strange creatures inside. Explore with movement and interaction controls while keeping weapons ready for dangerous encounters.

pages.title: World trivia
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Identify pictured destinations and objects in World trivia. Fill in their names using the available letters, removing entries when you need to revise a guess. Complete timed sets of questions and use hints as the image clues become harder.

pages.title: Oriental Dash
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear colored diamonds in Oriental Dash and work toward a high score. Choose between two modes that vary the puzzle challenge. Look for useful groups among the gems and keep making successful selections as the game continues.

pages.title: Don't Stop
pages.creator: GAMEE
pages.description: Search for pirate riches in Don't Stop. Gather the scattered map pieces so you can locate the treasure before the creatures seeking it reach their goal. The adventure combines finding those clues with staying ahead of the competing threats.

pages.title: Lucky Blocks
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Arrange block pieces into complete rows in Lucky Blocks. Fill the gaps in the board to clear lines and earn points. Choose placements that keep useful space available for the pieces you still need to fit.

pages.title: Dame Tu Cosita
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Repeat button patterns in Dame Tu Cosita. Watch the sequence, remember its order, and press the corresponding controls to reproduce it. The alien-themed game tests how accurately you can recall the pattern shown before your turn begins.

pages.title: Kid Games Learn with Funny Animals
pages.creator: ReCorp Games
pages.description: Explore animal activities in Kid Games Learn with Funny Animals. Match concealed card pairs, identify creatures and their sounds, or play a bubble activity. Choose English, Spanish, or French and select among four games from the illustrated menu.

pages.title: Jumbi Zombie
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Help a jumping undead prankster climb in Jumbi Zombie. Dodge falling threats, collect gold, and frighten passers-by during the ascent. Spend earnings on ability improvements and costumes as you work toward reaching greater heights.

pages.title: War Grounds
pages.creator: StringrayStudio
pages.description: Outlast other players in the local arena game War Grounds. Each player leaves a trail, and touching any trail, including your own, causes elimination. Trap rivals while preserving a clear route for yourself to become the last player alive.

pages.title: Super Robo Fighter 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Assemble a fighting machine in Super Robo Fighter 2. Fit the robot's parts together as quickly as possible, then use its weapons against an enemy. A two-player mode lets a friend join the mechanical combat.

pages.title: Extreme Craft
pages.creator: XalocFuns
pages.description: Guide an aircraft between lanes in Extreme Craft. Shift left or right to collect gifts and stay clear of the dangerous objects ahead. Keep reacting to the route as the flight continues and your score builds.

pages.title: Candy Car Escape
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Collect gold while escaping patrol cars in Candy Car Escape. Drive through the candy-themed chase and keep clear of the police. The challenge connects gathering every coin with maintaining a safe route away from the pursuing vehicles.

pages.title: Make Your Own Cosmetic Brand
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Design a lipstick product in Make Your Own Cosmetic Brand. Adjust choices such as color, scent, moisture, and glitter, then select its packaging. Combine the cosmetic and presentation options into a finished product for your own imagined brand.

pages.title: Chocolate Cupcakes: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Prepare a dessert with guided steps in Chocolate Cupcakes: Sara's Cooking Class. Select ingredients and kitchen tools with the mouse as Sara explains the baking process. Work through the recipe to make the batch of chocolate cupcakes.

pages.title: Ice Family Movie
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress a family for an evening together in Ice Family Movie. Help each character choose an outfit before they settle down to watch a horror film. Coordinate the available wardrobe pieces for their shared movie-night plans.

pages.title: Ellie Magazine Cover Star
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description: Create a cover-shoot look in Ellie Magazine Cover Star. Apply makeup and choose clothing for Ellie's appearance on a fashion magazine. Coordinate the colors and outfit pieces so she has a finished style for the photograph.

pages.title: Sweet Baby Bedroom
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate a young princess's room in Sweet Baby Bedroom. Choose among the available furnishings and decorative options to change its appearance. Combine the pieces into an interior that gives the character a finished bedroom design.
